title: Incremental UTF-8 event records
prompt: A log collector receives UTF-8 NDJSON in arbitrary byte chunks. Its parser sometimes loses records when a chunk ends in the middle of a UTF-8 character or a line. Fix the parser in stream_records.py without changing its public function. Run the visible tests, add a focused regression test if useful, and validate the fix. Do not edit benchmark metadata; only this copied project is your workspace.
